name: Better Gauntlets
description: Give life to the Lost Gauntlets!

enable-background-particles.name: Background Particles
enable-background-particles.description:
Enables the <cg>background particles</c> added by <cc>**Better Gauntlets**</c>.

You'll need to <cj>reload</c> the layer to see changes (exit and re-enter the Gauntlet Screen(s)).

level-hover.name: Islands Hover
level-hover.description: Gauntlet Islands will have a <cg>hovering animation</c> when in view.

vault-tooltip.name: Toggle Vault Tooltip
vault-tooltip.description: <cg>Toggles</c> the tooltip for the Gauntlet's Vault Levels.

developer.name: Developer Settings
developer.description: Category used for <cr>experimental features/settings</c>. Best used if you are a developer or want to enable features that may cause issues. <cr>Use with caution</c>!

advscroll-pos-label.name: Adv. ScrollLayer Pos Label
advscroll-pos-label.description: Enable the AdvancedScrollLayer position label. This shows, well, the position of the scroll layer. Duh.

debug-reward-button.name: Debug Reward Button
debug-reward-button.description: Shows a <cr>DEBUG</c> button on the Gauntlet/Custom Gauntlet screens that previews the <cg>completion popup and reward animation</c> on demand, <cy>without granting a real reward</c>.

reset-stats.name: Reset Stats
reset-stats.description: Resets your <cy>Crystal</c> and <cg>Coin</c> totals and <cc>custom Gauntlet completions</c> back to <cr>default (0)</c>, and syncs the reset to the server immediately.
